message.content:
At a pressure of **10 kPa** (≈ 0.1 atm) water freezes at roughly **–2 °C**.  
The melting/freezing temperature of ice drops as the external pressure falls, so at this low pressure the solid–liquid equilibrium lies a couple of degrees below the standard 0 °C point.
